text: Auto Labels classify incoming email as it arrives, separating marketing, cold pitches, and social updates from important mail
quote: With Auto Labels, Superhuman AI will automatically separate marketing, cold pitches, and social network updates, so you can respond faster to what matters most.

text: Users can create custom Auto Labels from short AI prompts (Business and Enterprise plans only)
quote: Custom Auto Labels let you categorize emails with your own AI prompts. (Available for our Business and Enterprise customers.)

text: Custom Auto Labels can be used to split the inbox into tabs
quote: you can make your own Auto Labels with short AI prompts, and then split your inbox into tabs using these custom Auto Labels.

text: Auto Archive automatically archives marketing, cold pitches, and social network updates
quote: Superhuman AI can automatically archive marketing, cold pitches, and social network updates. Turn on Auto Archive, and eliminate inbox clutter for good.

text: Split Inbox divides the inbox into user-defined categories such as VIP, Notifications, Calendar, or Team
quote: in Superhuman Mail, you can design your own categories: like "VIP", "Notifications", "Calendar", or "Team".

text: Users can focus on one topic and work through emails of the same type together
quote: you can focus on a specific topic — and get through emails of the same type, at the same time.

text: Every email that needs a reply automatically gets a draft that can be edited and sent
quote: with Auto Drafts 2.0, every message that needs a reply comes with a draft. You can just edit and send.

text: AI drafts match the user's voice and tone, adapting the style for each recipient
quote: Every draft matches your voice and tone, using your unique style for each person.

text: Auto Drafts pull context from other emails, the calendar, and web research, and can insert availability
quote: Auto Drafts now gather context from your inbox, your calendar, and the web. They can use information from other emails, insert availability, and conduct research online.

text: AI turns a few jotted phrases into a full email in the user's voice, based on emails they have already sent
quote: Just jot down some phrases, and we'll turn them into a full email. Best of all, the email sounds like you. Superhuman AI matches the voice and tone in the emails you've already sent

text: Plain-language instructions, such as 'write in lowercase' or a booking link, personalize AI writing and scheduling
quote: Add plain-language instructions like "write in lowercase" or "use this booking link" to personalize your writing and scheduling features.

text: Users are automatically reminded to follow up on emails that need a response, with a draft ready to send
quote: If your email needs a response, you’re automatically reminded to follow up—with a draft already written and ready to send.

text: One prompt can check which emails were read, draft nudges, and send each one when the recipient is most likely to open it
quote: Superhuman Mail can check which emails have been read, draft all the nudges, and send at the time each recipient is most likely to open it.

text: Ask AI answers natural-language questions about the inbox, such as flight or offsite details, without needing to know keywords or senders
quote: Just ask: _"where is the q2 offsite"_, _"when is my flight"_, _"where am I staying"_, and we'll immediately generate succinct answers.

text: Users can ask follow-up questions in a conversation with Ask AI
quote: You can ask follow-up questions in a conversation.

text: An MCP connection links the inbox and calendar to Claude, ChatGPT, and other assistants to summarize threads, draft and send email, and schedule meetings
quote: Superhuman Mail MCP connects your inbox and calendar into Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants—so you can summarize threads, draft and send emails, and schedule meetings without jumping between apps.

text: Claude or ChatGPT can read, draft, and send email directly from a single prompt
quote: Connect Claude or ChatGPT directly to your inbox to read, draft, and send emails with a single prompt — no copy-pasting required.

text: Drafts can be reviewed in Superhuman or edited and sent directly from the external AI assistant
quote: Every draft matches your voice and tone, using your unique style for each person. You can review the drafts in Superhuman Mail, or edit and send directly from your AI assistant.

text: External AI tools can run Superhuman-specific features: Split Inbox triage, sent-email tracking, Read Statuses, Smart Send, and Ask AI
quote: You can also do things that are uniquely Superhuman: triage by Split Inbox, track sent emails, check Read Statuses, Smart Send, and Ask AI.

text: Every send action requires the user's explicit approval
quote: Every send action requires your explicit approval, so you stay in control.

text: Multiple Gmail and Outlook accounts can be connected and managed from one AI assistant
quote: Connect all your Gmail and Outlook accounts, including work, personal, and side projects. Manage every inbox and calendar from one AI assistant, without complicated workarounds.

text: Users can switch between Outlook and Gmail accounts instantly without changing apps
quote: you can instantly switch between Outlook and Gmail accounts without switching apps.

text: Works fully offline and stays usable on poor internet connections
quote: It works perfectly offline. It works even when online, and your internet connection is terrible.

text: Search works without a network connection
quote: Available: The search shouldn't require a network connection to function.

text: Calendars from all Gmail and Outlook accounts can be combined in one view and toggled on and off
quote: You can add all your Gmail and Outlook account calendars, and easily toggle them on and off. One single, consolidated view when you need it

text: A keyboard shortcut (2) opens the full calendar inside the client, and 1 returns to the inbox
quote: To see your full calendar, just hit 2 or tap the calendar icon. (And hit 1 to jump back to your inbox.)

text: When an email mentions a date, that day's calendar appears in a side panel
quote: When any email mentions a date, Superhuman Mail will show your day in the right side panel — so you always have context.

text: A secondary time zone can be added to make cross-time-zone scheduling easier
quote: Add a secondary time zone, so scheduling between San Francisco and New York (or London and Tokyo) is effortless.

text: Find Time shows when all added teammates are free, for team scheduling
quote: Simply add teammates, click "Find Time", and instantly see when everyone is free.

text: Cmd+K opens a command palette that can run any action and teaches its keyboard shortcut
quote: Cmd+K brings up Superhuman Command, where you can instantly do any action — and also learn the shortcut for next time.

text: Fast keyboard shortcuts and Instant Intro speed up replies
quote: You can reply to important messages faster with blazingly fast shortcuts and features like Instant Intro.

text: Snippets insert saved phrases, paragraphs, or whole emails with a keyboard shortcut
quote: With Snippets, you can automate typing and push past this limit. Insert commonly-used phrases, paragraphs, or whole emails with a simple keyboard shortcut.

text: Snippets can be shared across a team for consistent messaging
quote: You can also share Snippets with your team, so your team can move faster, with consistent, up-to-date, and high-performing messaging.

text: Read statuses are shared across the team, so anyone can follow up with full context
quote: Read statuses are now shared across your team, so anybody can follow up with full context.

text: Team Reply Indicators show when a teammate is replying, to avoid duplicate work
quote: See when your team is replying, so you can avoid double work and embarrassing collisions.

text: Email Assistant works inside Gmail or Outlook to sort mail, draft replies, clear noise, and remind about follow-ups
quote: Email Assistant works inside Gmail or Outlook to sort incoming messages, draft replies in your voice, clear the noise, and remind you to follow up.

text: A rebuilt mobile app with easier writing and one-tap key actions
quote: A fully rebuilt mobile experience—writing feels effortless, interactions feel intuitive, and key actions are just a tap away.
